faqs.question: Which Gulf County school years are available here?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 regular student calendar is available. Later school-year calendars have not been verified here.

faqs.question: Does this calendar cover every Gulf County program?
faqs.answer: This page follows the district’s regular student calendar. Check directly with Gulf District Adult School or any separate virtual or other program for its schedule. The bell-time entries apply only to the two named junior/senior high schools.

hero.heading: Gulf County School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Gulf District Schools students start August 10, 2026, and finish May 28, 2027. Fall break is October 12–13; spring break is March 15–19.
hero.desktopDescription: Gulf District Schools' October break lasts two days, and students return from Christmas break on January 5, after the January 4 teacher inservice day. December 18 and May 28 are early-dismissal days with no lunch. Local school times differ: Port St. Joe uses Eastern Time; Wewahitchka uses Central Time.

editorialSummary.heading: Fall break is only two days in Gulf County
paragraphs: Students have no classes Monday and Tuesday, October 12–13, 2026, for fall break. The scheduled return is Wednesday, October 14. Two other dates, September 25 and October 30, are teacher inservice days when students stay home. Thanksgiving break runs November 23–27.

Christmas break runs from December 21 through January 1. Students remain home Monday, January 4, for teacher inservice and return Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends, the stretch without regular classes lasts from December 19 through January 4.
Spring break is March 15–19, 2027. Classes resume March 22, and March 22–25 are scheduled school days before the separate Good Friday holiday on March 26. May 28 is the final student day.

December 18, 2026, and May 28, 2027, are school days with early dismissal and no lunch. May 28 also ends the student year. Confirm the shortened dismissal time with your school before arranging pickup; Port St. Joe uses Eastern Time, while Wewahitchka uses Central Time.
highlights: Fall break: October 12–13; classes resume October 14.
Christmas break ends January 1; students return January 5.
Spring break is March 15–19; Good Friday is March 26.
December 18 and May 28: early dismissal, no lunch.
Port St. Joe uses Eastern Time; Wewahitchka uses Central Time.

about.dataSource: The one-page Gulf County School District 2026-2027 PDF is the student-date source. about.processing: Read all dated captions and reviewed the complete rendered page and legend. Pink means Teacher Planning / No School; green means Holiday / Schools Closed; blue marks grading-period ends; orange marks progress reports; purple marks report cards. The diagonal Early Dismissal / No Lunch symbol appears on December 18 and May 28. Each is a single canonical event retaining its grading-end meaning; May 28 also retains the last-day meaning. All 210 weekdays from August 10 to May 28 minus 30 no-class weekdays reconcile to the printed 180 student days. The pre-Christmas period through December 18 has 84 attendance weekdays, and the January 5-May 28 period has 96, agreeing with the printed semester subtotals; no unprinted semester-boundary event is added. Keep official named break ranges separate from weekend-inclusive planning spans and the January 4 inservice day. Return dates are derived from the published schedule. Do not bridge March 22-25 to combine Spring Break with Good Friday. New Year’s Day is already within Christmas Break and is not counted twice. Pre-year teacher planning, post-year teacher reporting and Memorial Day after the final student date are omitted. No make-up rule, final report-card release, senior endpoint or ceremony date is invented. The article is dated March 10, 2026, but does not date the currently linked v2 revision; calendar publication, approval and revision fields remain null. The PDF metadata has a stale Lee County title; the printed Gulf County heading governs identity. File timestamps and the April upload path are not Board approval evidence. Port St. Joe Jr./Sr. High posts a 2026–2027 bell schedule effective October 14, 2026, with regular dismissal at 2:45 p.m. and half-day dismissal at 11:44 a.m., Eastern Time. Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High posts a regular dismissal of 3:00 p.m. and BNL dismissal at noon, Central Time, without a stated effective date. Neither high-school schedule establishes elementary dismissal times. School-clock timezone labels combine the school locations, the district’s two-time-zone statement and official campus Eastern/Central notices. America/New_York is the Port St. Joe district-office reference, not a claim that all campuses share that zone. Date-only events are shared district dates.

faqs.question: When does school start in Gulf County for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Students start Monday, August 10, 2026. August 3 is the teachers’ first day, not the first day for students.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Gulf County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last student day. Students attend but leave early, and no lunch is served. The fourth nine-week grading period also ends that day.

faqs.question: Does the 2026–2027 calendar cover schools in both Port St. Joe and Wewahitchka?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is Gulf District Schools’ regular student calendar for the district. Bell times and school-specific events may differ. Confirm separate adult, virtual or other program schedules with the program.

faqs.question: When is fall break in Gulf County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Monday and Tuesday, October 12–13, 2026, not a full week. Including the preceding weekend, students have October 10–13 off. Classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: Is there school on Columbus Day, October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. October 12 is the first day of the district’s October 12–13 fall break. The official school calendar labels these dates Fall Break rather than listing a separate Columbus Day holiday.

faqs.question: Which teacher inservice days have no classes for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no school on September 25 and October 30, 2026, or January 4, 2027. The January inservice day follows Christmas break.

faqs.question: Are Gulf County schools closed on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, September 7, 2026, is a school holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is marked as Veterans Day, with no student classes.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Gulf County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas or winter break in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Christmas Break. It runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a separate teacher inservice day without student classes.

faqs.question: When do Gulf County students return after Christmas break?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Christmas break ends January 1, and Monday, January 4 is a teacher inservice day. The district's events listing also identifies January 5 as Students Return.

faqs.question: Is there school on January 4, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 4, is a teacher inservice day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Is school closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a school holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is listed as a school holiday.

faqs.question: When is Gulf County spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15–19, 2027. With both weekends, students are off March 13–21 and are scheduled back Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a school holiday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027, is a separate school holiday. March 22–25 are scheduled school days after spring break, and classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Is there school on Memorial Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled on Memorial Day, Monday, May 31, 2027. The student school year ends Friday, May 28; Memorial Day falls after the last student day.

faqs.question: Which 2026–2027 dates have early dismissal?
faqs.answer: Friday, December 18, 2026, and Friday, May 28, 2027. Both are student attendance days with early dismissal and no lunch. Confirm the dismissal time for your child’s school.

faqs.question: What does BNL mean on the school calendar?
faqs.answer: The posted Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High bell schedule defines BNL as Breakfast, No Lunch. The district calendar marks December 18 and May 28 for early dismissal with no lunch. Confirm breakfast service and pickup arrangements with your school.

faqs.question: What are the regular school hours at Port St. Joe Jr./Sr. High?
faqs.answer: The 2026–2027 bell schedule effective October 14, 2026, lists doors opening for breakfast at 7:45 a.m., the first bell at 8:20 a.m., first period at 8:25 a.m. and regular dismissal at 2:45 p.m., all Eastern Time.

faqs.question: What time is half-day dismissal at Port St. Joe Jr./Sr. High?
faqs.answer: Its bell schedule effective October 14, 2026, lists half-day dismissal at 11:44 a.m. Eastern Time. Confirm with the school that this schedule applies to each calendar-marked early-dismissal date.

faqs.question: What are the regular school hours at Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High?
faqs.answer: The posted schedule lists a first bell at 8:15 a.m., first period at 8:20 a.m. and regular dismissal at 3:00 p.m., all Central Time. The web page does not state an effective school year, so confirm current arrangements.

faqs.question: What time is BNL dismissal at Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High?
faqs.answer: The posted BNL schedule lists dismissal at 12:00 noon Central Time. Because that page does not identify a school year, confirm the time for December 18 and May 28 with the school.

faqs.question: What time do Gulf County elementary schools dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The published junior/senior high bell schedules do not establish early-release times for Port St. Joe Elementary or Wewahitchka Elementary. Check directly with your elementary school before arranging pickup.

faqs.question: Do Port St. Joe and Wewahitchka use the same time zone?
faqs.answer: No. Port St. Joe uses Eastern Time; Wewahitchka uses Central Time, one hour behind. Check the local time on each campus’s bell schedule or event notice.

faqs.question: When are progress reports scheduled in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are listed for September 9 and November 13, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar lists October 22, 2026, and January 13 and March 31, 2027. It does not give a release date for final fourth-quarter report cards.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: They end October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 12 and May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 are also early-dismissal attendance days.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the 2026–2027 Gulf County school year?
faqs.answer: The official district PDF lists 180 student days: 84 in the first semester and 96 in the second. Early-dismissal days still count as student attendance days.

faqs.question: Are hurricane make-up days listed on the 2026–2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: No specific hurricane make-up dates or activation order are printed. After any weather closure, check district announcements and school messages for changes.

faqs.question: When is Port St. Joe High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district's Board Meetings & District Events calendar lists Port St. Joe Jr./Sr. High graduation for Thursday, May 27, 2027, from 7:00 to 9:00 p.m. The event title uses EST. Confirm the current local time and ceremony venue with the school.

faqs.question: When is Wewahitchka High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High graduation for Friday, May 28, 2027, from 8:00 to 10:00 p.m. The event title uses EST, although Wewahitchka follows Central Time. Confirm the local start time and venue with the school before attending.

faqs.question: When is the Port St. Joe High School baccalaureate in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists the Port St. Joe Jr./Sr. High baccalaureate for Wednesday, May 26, 2027, from 5:30 to 6:30 p.m. The event title uses EST. Confirm the local time and venue with the school.

faqs.question: When is the Wewahitchka High School baccalaureate in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists the Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High baccalaureate for Wednesday, May 26, 2027, from 7:00 to 8:00 p.m. The event title uses EST, although Wewahitchka follows Central Time. Confirm the local time and venue with the school.

faqs.question: Where can families find open houses, athletics and other school events?
faqs.answer: Use the districtwide events calendar to find activities for Port St. Joe Elementary, Port St. Joe Jr./Sr. High, Wewahitchka Elementary and Wewahitchka Jr./Sr. High. Check individual event listings for times and locations, and confirm arrangements with the school.

faqs.question: Where can I get the official Gulf County 2026–2027 calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026–2027 School Calendar page links the official one-page PDF. You can also use the official PDF link on this page. Check the district website for later revisions.

faqs.question: Where are the 2026–2027 statewide testing dates?
faqs.answer: The district publishes a separate 2026–27 Uniform Statewide Assessment Calendar under Student Testing & Assessment. Testing schedules are not included in the one-page student holiday calendar.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: The PDF is district-published but prints no Board approval date. The March 10 article predates the current v2 upload; it does not establish when this specific revision was published. Calendar approvedAt, publishedAt and revision dates remain null.

The May 2027 ceremony titles use EST despite the district spanning Eastern and Central time zones and May falling in daylight saving time. Preserve the listed times in FAQ text without converting them; families should confirm local times and venues with the schools. These activities are separate from annual student-calendar events.

The annual PDF labels Christmas Break December 21–January 1, while the Board Meetings & District Events listing shows December 21–January 3 and separately lists January 4 as a teacher planning day. The Port St. Joe Elementary event displays December 21–January 5, but the Board listing explicitly identifies January 5 as Students Return. Keep January 5 as the scheduled return. Do not treat the elementary event's displayed end date as an additional no-class day or assume a technical explanation for the difference.
